title: Dynamic SQL executed from text (plsql) — review required
description: A plsql routine executes a statement built as text. If any part of that text is untrusted input, the statement structure is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the execution; the reviewer confirms the text is constant or parameterized.
remediation: Use bind variables passed with USING, and keep input out of the statement text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.

tests.line: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id;
# audit: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ' || v_id; present
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :1' USING v_id;
# verified: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :1' USING v_id;
